messages.text: How are you feeling about money?

Honestly? I've got $75K to $119K in debt saved [ev_A_009]. I'm making no salary (base pay) [ev_A_009]. If everything stopped tomorrow I'd have 0 months of expenses [ev_A_009]. That's the part of this life I think about most.

I see it differently. I've got $101K to $145K saved [ev_B_009]. I'm making $182K a year [ev_B_009]. If everything stopped tomorrow I'd have 12.8–24 months of expenses [ev_B_009]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
Fair, but from where I'm standing: What worries me most: savings run out before revenue arrives [ev_A_007]. Stress? medium [ev_A_006]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
